verseText: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
meaning: Knowing the truth and wisdom of God is a priceless treasure. It is more valuable than any amount of gold or silver.

recall.question: What does this verse say is better than gold?

meaning.question: Wisdom is knowing the right way to live. Why is it more valuable than riches?
choices: It helps us make choices that honor God
Wise people earn lots of gold
It makes other people admire us

application.prompt: Who wouldn't love having a giant pile of gold? But God says the wisdom to know right from wrong is an even greater treasure. Can you think of a situation where making a wise choice saved you from a lot of trouble?
